scope: Website release of all 500 S&P 500 companies (November 1 snapshot) with the live judging window opened. GitHub main was updated while the repository stays private until the final latest-quarter top-up on November 4.
repository_visibility: private on November 1; made public after the November 4 top-up

export.credential_scan: Known local credential values, the SEC User-Agent, the Modal endpoint, Gmail addresses and token patterns: no undisclosed matches; the exact documented DUMMY_KEY fixture digest is excluded. This is not a guarantee that every unknown credential is detectable.
export.push: Four commits under the release identity (two media commits, the evidence database, then the rest) because a single HTTPS push timed out on a slow uplink; the last three went over SSH. The pushed tree equals the reviewed export tree.
